doc.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

title: Waldo Carter and the invitation to hear his tapes
summary: Boyhood friend Waldo Carter, a trumpeter who played with Harry James; Alley repeats his invitation to hear his cassettes.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: One of my best friends when I was a kid was named Waldo Carter, he played trumpet with — he used to play with Harry James and he played with a lot of the big bands. He called me every morning. He played with beautiful tone. If you ever come down to my house—
I’ll give it a try. I’ll let you know where I am.
Well it’s just a little cassette. It’s not a professional tape.
